highlights: sought after area of hurworth place
summary: A well presented three bedroom semi detached home ideally situated in the heart of the highly sought after village of Hurworth Place. This much improved home has under gone a full renovation including re wiring.
description:
LOUNGE A spacious and inviting lounge, beautifully presented and centred around an attractive feature fireplace, creating a warm and cosy focal point. French doors open seamlessly onto the rear landscaped garden, allowing plenty of natural light to flood the room and providing an ideal space for both relaxing and entertaining.

KITCHEN A stylish and well appointed kitchen featuring attractive sage green wall and base units, complemented by a solid butcher's block work surface. The space is fitted with a built-in electric oven and a separate gas hob with an overhead extractor fan, alongside a decorative wine rack adding a touch of character. This fully integrated kitchen also includes, a dish washer, washer dryer, fridge and freezer. Additionally, two doors provide access to useful storage spaces, enhancing the practicality of this well-designed kitchen.

MASTER BEDROOM A generously sized master bedroom positioned to the rear of the property, offering a peaceful and private outlook. The room benefits from fitted floor-to-ceiling wardrobes providing excellent storage, while still allowing ample space for additional furniture and bedside tables.

BEDROOM A well proportioned second bedroom featuring a fitted storage area, offering practical and convenient space for clothing and everyday essentials. This versatile room is ideal as a guest bedroom or children's room.

BEDROOM A versatile third bedroom enjoying an outlook to the front of the property, offering a bright and functional space and fitted storage. Ideal for use as a home office or additional single bedroom.

SHOWER ROOM A stylish and contemporary bathroom fitted with a walk-in shower, complete with an overhead shower head and sleek glass shower screen. The space is enhanced by eye-catching sage statement tiles, creating a modern and calming feel. A WC and wash hand basin are complemented by a heated towel warmer.

EXTERNALLY A well maintained rear garden, partially laid to patio providing an ideal space for outdoor seating and entertaining. The garden has a lawned area and raised flower beds add colour and character. A raised gravel area at the rear creates an additional seating space, perfect for relaxing and enjoying the outdoors. To the front there is access to a single garage via a tarmacked drive which can accommodate up to four vehicles. The front garden is laid to lawn with a small planted area.
